div.head: Quadr Ded 2
div.ab: Hæc ipse mecum reputans, unice tibi, quasi cordi meo, loquor, absonum et eneruem meæ rusticitatis sermonem non erubescens, dum tuæ paream uoluntati; cui me diutius debitorem ingenii mei diffidentia, sollicitudo plurima, nec ubique completiua desideria reddiderunt.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 529 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

note.seg: Wörtlich heisst das: Dedikat hat vor längerer Zeit den Verf. angeregt, das Werk zu schreiben, was u. 4 bestätigt. Doch könnte es blosse Phrase aus damaliger Stilistik sein
Literally this means: the dedicatee prompted the author some time ago to write the work, which is confirmed below 4. It could, however, be a mere phrase from the stylistic conventions of the time
